title: Staged activation framework for cost-saving recommendations with canary validation and operator checkpoints
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Automatic application of batching/caching recommendations can yield substantial cost savings but risks subtle regressions in tail latency, token-level correctness for structured outputs, and throughput under realistic traffic patterns. Proposal: implement a staged activation framework that treats every Optimize suggestion as an "activation bundle" that must pass a simulated traffic canary, a lightweight operator checkpoint, and an automated rollback policy driven by telemetry thresholds. The flow will: 1) provision a safe canary instance with the suggested config applied to a mirrored subset of traffic (simulated or sampled); 2) run deterministic validation and synthetic request suites (prompt/response invariants, structured output schema checks); 3) evaluate telemetry windows (P95/P99 latency, token error rates, quality regressions measured by eval prompts); 4) surface a concise operator checkpoint UI with a one-click approve/abort that includes risk signals and diffs; 5) if approved, ramp in stages (1%, 10%, 50%, 100%) with automated safety gates at each stage and transparent rollback hooks. Trade-offs: adds latency to deployment of recommendations but drastically reduces customer outage risk. Will rely on existing routing and KV cache isolation primitives and add a traffic simulation runner to avoid hitting production customers during validation.
tasks: Design canary activation spec and activation-bundle schema
Implement traffic simulator that replays recent request distributions against a canary instance
Build telemetry gate engine (threshold rules, windowing, alerting hooks)
Create operator checkpoint UI surface and approval API
Integrate staged ramp controller with existing routing/policy layer
Add rollback choreography and a quick-revert endpoint
End-to-end integration tests and chaos scenarios
Documentation and runbook for SRE/solutions teams
acceptance_criteria: Activation bundle can be created and stored for an Optimize suggestion with metadata and diffs
Traffic simulator can replay a 24h sample against a canary without impacting live production tenants
Telemetry gates fire correctly on injected regressions in staging and block rollouts
Operator checkpoint displays config diff, cost delta estimate, and key risk signals in < 5 seconds
Staged ramp completes from 1% to 100% when gates remain green; automated rollback reverses changes and logs actions when gates fail
E2E tests cover synthetic quality regressions, latency spikes, and rollback validation
comments: 2026-02-20: Ticket created during Optimize roadmap planning session. Assigned to Miguel for implementation planning.
2026-02-25: Initial design doc uploaded to Confluence (link in links). Suggestion: keep first ramp stage at 1% for 24h, but also add a simulated 30m fast-pass for low-risk suggestions.
2026-03-03: Architecture review with runtime and routing teams. Runtime team to expose cache isolation hooks; routing team will add a 'canary' traffic tag.
2026-03-07: Prototype of traffic simulator accepted; found edge case with long-tail sequences causing KV cache churn—added synthetic KV warmup in simulator.
2026-03-12: Design review feedback: product wants a cost-savings estimate shown in the operator checkpoint; added model to compute token cost delta and expected monthly savings.
2026-03-14: Working on telemetry gate engine implementation. Blocked briefly by need for a consolidated metrics view (ENG-62398) — coordinating with Observability team.
notes: We intentionally separate simulated validation from live canary sampling to give product teams a quick low-risk signal before operator review. Expect 3 sprints of delivery with iterative hardening after initial rollout.
